S.FORM: pkayal masu' pkayal yow na musa pisa btiyux sa'ing sali laga, htgan na sali nya ina ga tna'an maras y'aya ptna cpung na btiyux uy. pisa tnman na knerin hiya ga ba'un mita maha pisa kwara y'aya innaras ro pisa btiyux galun naha.cpngan pkayal naha musa pisa naras ina. krryax hiya ga musa utux patus repu, utux lukus kaga, y'aya pnmahan, y'aya na tpuyan, tnunan lukus mayung kaga, cpngan naha btiyux hiya ga gluw mlikuiy utux alang ga musa mluyak rgyax, ro musa mleh ro cabu 'cyux, lmon pnba' kwara bttiyux ro musa ms'un sa'ing mrkyas naha.
S.PHON: pkajal ma[s|ɕ]uʔ pkajal jow na mu[s|ɕ]a pi[s|ɕ]a βtijux [s|ɕ]aʔiŋ [s|ɕ]ali laɣa ħtɣan na [s|ɕ]ali nja ina ɣa tnaʔan mara[s|ɕ] jʔaja ptna [ʦ|ʨ]puŋ na βtijux uj pi[s|ɕ]a tnman na knerin ħija ɣa βaʔun mita maħa pi[s|ɕ]a kwara jʔaja innara[s|ɕ] ro pi[s|ɕ]a βtijux ɣalun naħa[ʦ|ʨ]pŋan pkajal naħa mu[s|ɕ]a pi[s|ɕ]a nara[s|ɕ] ina krrjax ħija ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a utux patu[s|ɕ] repu utux luku[s|ɕ] kaɣa jʔaja pnmaħan jʔaja na tpujan tnunan luku[s|ɕ] majuŋ kaɣa [ʦ|ʨ]pŋan naħa βtijux ħija ɣa ɣluw mlikuij utux alaŋ ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a mlujak rɣjax ro mu[s|ɕ]a mleħ ro [ʦ|ʨ]aβu ʔ[ʦ|ʨ]jux lmon pnβaʔ kwara βttijux ro mu[s|ɕ]a m[s|ɕ]ʔun [s|ɕ]aʔiŋ mrkja[s|ɕ] naħa
